answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond native tokens to validate network states, transforming the myth of costless identity into a harsh economic fable. An attacker cannot simply voyage across multiple identities without staking significant capital, which remains locked in a shale of immutable cryptographic contracts. This ensures that the cost of an attack scales linearly with the stake required to influence the consensus process, effectively deterring malicious actors.
